To: [Recipient Name]
Address: [Recipient Address]

Date: [Date]

Re: Outstanding Payment – Invoice #[Invoice Number]

Dear [Recipient Name],

This letter serves as a formal notice that the payment in the amount of $[Amount Due] remains outstanding for invoice #[Invoice Number], issued on [Issue Date], with a due date of [Due Date]. As of today, the balance is still unpaid.

Please remit the full payment immediately to avoid further action. If you have already processed this payment, kindly disregard this notice.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
